atoms.b: Can light cause damage to our eyes?
((++Yes No)), light ((++can cannot)) damage our eyes.
Too ((++much little)) exposure to light can damage our eyes.
Our pupils automatically change size to either let in more or less light. When a light is too bright, our pupils get ((++smaller bigger)) to help protect our eyes.
Can you do anything else to protect your eyes from bright light?
You can protect your eyes from the Sun by not looking directly at it! You can also wear sunglasses that protect against ((++UV_rays lasers)) or a hat that shields your eyes.
UV stands for ((++ultra_violet ultimate_vision)). In large amounts, UV light can damage our eyes.
